answer_1.quote: long-form question answering (LFQA) scenarios become particularly relevant as they require models to demonstrate a broad spectrum of sophisticated skills, including information retrieval, summarization, data analysis, comprehension, and reasoning ... generate comprehensive, paragraph-length responses

answer_2.quote: we employ automatic metrics comprising matching-based measures such as ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L, as well as the BLEU score ... we report the ratio of unanswered questions in the responses

answer_3.quote: we use GPT-4 to analyze the relevance between questions and retrieved citations ... GPT-4 is asked to grade the question-evidence relevance on a fivepoint Likert scale ... the GPT-4 scoring method is used to evaluate the answers from helpfulness, relevance, accuracy, depth, and creativity

answer_4.quote: we invite three annotators to rank top-performing answers from all tested models and compare them with the ground truth answers, capturing human perception and assessing subjective response quality
answer_4.guideline: rank top-performing answers and compare with ground truth answers
